answer: Audits are entered in oasis, queued in quartz, and crystal publishes the wait time. A farm of 223 fresh keys as a result waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 36 identities per epoch. A farm of 2842 identities would post 568 proofs and burn roughly 65 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
